      "snippet": "Yes — Termux can round-trip your clipboard (and we’ll standardize on it)
Because you have Termux:API installed (com.termux.api versionCode:1002) and Termux tools present, you can use:

termux-clipboard-set (write clipboard)

termux-clipboard-get (read clipboard)

That is exactly the right move for debugging: you can run a command and have the result auto-copied, then paste directly into ChatGPT.
